ev.q: Overall, 1,471 black MSM had positive tests for HIV infection in 2016
Among the 374,871 CDC-funded HIV tests provided in non–health care facilities
552 (67%) were linked to HIV medical care within 90 days of diagnosis
Newly diagnosed HIV infections among black MSM % positive
black MSM received 6% of the HIV tests provided and accounted for 36% of the new HIV diagnoses
Compared with tests performed in metropolitan jurisdictions, tests performed in urban jurisdictions were more likely to yield new diagnoses
The adjusted prevalence ratio of being linked to HIV medical care within 90 days was higher for those living in urban areas
which is below the 2020 national goal of linking at least 85%
Health departments and CBOs submitted deidentified program data about services provided through a secure, online CDC-supported system

methods_quotes.q: Multivariate binomial regression was used to assess the association between demographic characteristics and newly diagnosed HIV infections
Data were stratified by the following characteristics: age group, first-time tested, and urbanicity.
